CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
